summary: Phase 6: Final Wiring & Production Readiness - Iteration 134. Tested all vehicle settlement endpoints and verified ListingDetailPage component wiring through code review. All 26 backend tests passed (100%).

fee_preview_endpoint.details: GET /api/vehicle-settlement/fee-preview/{price} returns correct fee breakdown with bilingual strings. Tested with $1,000, $5,000, $10,000, $25,000, $50,000. Rejects 0 and negative prices with 400.

seller_contact_endpoint.details: GET /api/auctions/{id}/seller-contact returns 401 for unauthenticated, 402 with bilingual message (message_en, message_fr) when no settlement exists

settlement_status_endpoint.details: GET /api/vehicle-settlement/{id}/status returns PENDING_CLOSE when no settlement exists, requires auth

confirm_card_verification_endpoint.details: POST /api/vehicle-settlement/confirm-card-verification marks card as verified, requires auth

verify_card_endpoint.details: POST /api/vehicle-settlement/verify-card creates SetupIntent with bilingual messages (message_en, message_fr). NOT tested live per instructions to avoid creating additional SetupIntents.

listing_detail_page_wiring.details: Code review verified: CrossBorderAdvisoryPanel, SellerContactGate, VehicleFeeBreakdown, CrossBorderBidModal all imported and conditionally rendered

cross_border_logic.details: isCrossBorder check (listing.country !== 'CA') implemented, CrossBorderAdvisoryPanel rendered for non-CA listings

cross_border_bid_modal_intercept.details: CrossBorderBidModal intercepts first bid on non-Canadian listings, crossBorderAccepted state tracked

cross_border_disclosure_in_bid.details: cross_border_disclosure_accepted included in bid payload when cross-border accepted

vehicle_fee_notice.details: Vehicle fee notice (data-testid='vehicle-fee-notice') rendered above Place Bid button for vehicle-category listings

seller_contact_gate_rendering.details: SellerContactGate rendered for won auctions (isAuctionWon check)

webhook_handlers.details: payment_intent.succeeded and payment_intent.payment_failed handlers present in /app/backend/routes/webhooks.py
